title: Historic Marburg outbreak hints at long-term viral hideout
title_zh: 历史上的马尔堡病毒暴发暗示病毒存在长期潜伏地
abstract: Sequencing of Marburg virus collected during Ethiopia’s first outbreak suggests that the pathogen is lurking in East and Central Africa.
abstract_zh: 对埃塞俄比亚首次暴发期间收集的马尔堡病毒进行测序表明，该病毒在东非和中非地区潜伏。
